basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a software developer for a small tech startup, and by night, I transform into a passionate gamer and DIY PC builder. My interests lie in gaming, tech innovations, and advocating for women's rights, often participating in discussions about gender equality. In the evenings and weekends, you'll find me online, either helping others build their dream PCs or engaging in thoughtful discussions on various topics. I'm currently single and enjoy my independence, spending my free time exploring the latest video games or tinkering with new hardware.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My passion for technology started at a young age, and I've built it up through a combination of formal education and self-teaching. I've assembled numerous PCs for myself and friends, and I stay updated with the latest trends in PC hardware.
